observations: Photo 0 shows several used engine and gearbox assemblies wrapped in clear plastic sheeting.
No brand, model, engine code, or year plate is legible in the photo.
The seller describes one Toyota Corolla 2010 2ZR set, but the photo shows multiple wrapped units.
Condition, mileage, and functionality cannot be assessed from still images of wrapped items.

claims.claim: Toyota Corolla 2010 engine and gear box 2ZR
claims.evidence: No readable plate or marking in photo 0; seller text alone is not proof.
Origin cannot be confirmed from a photo of wrapped engines.
No running test or diagnostic shown in photo 0.
Sound cannot be assessed from a still photo.
No odometer or service history visible.
Plastic wrapping does not prove internal condition.

risks.risk: Engine may be seized, damaged, or non-functional
risks.proof: Video of the engine cranking and running, or a compression test result

risks.risk: Gearbox may be faulty, mismatched, or missing internals
risks.proof: Video of gearbox shifting through gears or bench inspection

risks.risk: Engine code may not be 2ZR or car may not be Corolla 2010
risks.proof: Clear close-up of the engine block code and identification plate

risks.risk: Mileage and 'never opened' claims cannot be verified
risks.proof: Service records or photos of the donor car odometer

risks.risk: Origin 'Tokunbo from Belgium' may be false

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the engine block code and any identification plate
Video of the engine starting and running with no abnormal noise
Video or photos showing the gearbox shifting through all gears
Photos of the donor car odometer and service history
response.reason: The exact model and engine code that set the price cannot be read from the photo, so even a worst-case price cannot be matched to a comparable without proof.
